The target executed after the page loaded and the Pending card rendered its two rows, and failed on its first planned assertion: the row carries sm:table-row (a 640px VIEWPORT breakpoint) and no [@container_(min-width:60rem)]:table-row, which is the G-37-14 root cause (the sidebar leaves the card ~398px at 768, but sm: had already chosen the table). The four sibling tests failed on their own planned assertions for the same cause: the CardContent is 'p-6 pt-0' with no [container-type:inline-size]; the distinct-threshold set is [] not ['60rem']; the email has [overflow-wrap:anywhere] but no container break-words; an OPEN row has no 'Expires' prefix (the only 'Expires' is the column header outside the row). Nothing failed on setup, import or fixture: the goods test (both actions h-11 w-full, named by the address) and all 57 pre-existing tests passed in the same run.
